register: plain slow explainer, calm teacher, light-theme cards; gear 3 hook and close, three music PUSHes; not horror, so no SCARY / Bear Markets rows

card_pick.why: ONE card in the whole video (CH2, the only bed change). The ledger has no BLOCKED card; book-flip and swap are fresh but need the canvas-draw-element render flag Mike has not accepted, so the Safe pick is the least recently used safe move: slide (last 10-22) beats flip (10-23) and cube (10-27). A plain push-in reads as the calm teacher turning to the next page, under the DSGN impact and the 1.0 s pause.

face_glitch_pick.why: Advisory slot: Blocks is the recent pick (10-27) and reads tech / hype; this is a slow debt explainer in a light theme with organic light leaks on every punch, so the warm radial film burn keeps face cuts, punches and leaks in ONE organic language. Intensity dialed low: 34 face edges in 12:27 must not strobe.

face_leak_set.why: All four are fresh (never used); the previous video's soft-short-1/2/4/5 are BLOCKED. Mixed looks by geometry: the 1.44 s soft sweep (low energy) is the default on the slow holds, the 0.4 s soft-short blink takes a join within about 0.9 s of a window edge or inside a tight join cluster (F14) so the leak never spills onto the cut or onto a clip insert. Alternated 6 / 8 and 7 / 9.

ai_still_glitch_pick.why: Advisory slot. Invert and VHS are fresh but wrong mood (a negative strobe / a tape-damage look on photoreal cinematic stills in a calm explainer). Turbulent Displace is the least recently used family (10-02, not in the last three videos) and its heat-haze molten warp IS the video's metaphor: dollars melting away. 1x / 2x medium-energy variants on the quiet hits, 3x on the Kaspa coin under the swell into PUSH #3; h / v alternated, never the same id twice in a row. Envato VIDEO b-roll never glitches.

melt_pick.why: Gated slot: nothing BLOCKED; MELT/Equidistant is the recent look (10-27, only-18-months-left), MELT/RGB last ran 10-23, four videos back, so it is the least recently used and outside the last three. The soft-falloff variants (0.84 s, medium energy) fit a slow chapter better than the hard RGB split; the 0.6 s soft-short takes the one callback melt. Chromatic channels drifting apart and re-fusing reads as 'this reflows into that', the transform move.

spin_pick.why: Gated slot: SPIN/Corner Swinging is BLOCKED, Corner Bounce and Shake are the last three videos' looks. SPIN/3D Side Ease last ran 09-28, the least recently used of the rest, and it is the one true 3D turn over mirrored padding (occlusion safe) that sells 'a new facet of the system' for the video's centerpiece diagram. Used once; the card is a slide, so the 3D language belongs to the marquee alone.
